source_scope: Historical 85-pair union, used only to annotate matching schemas; its totals are not this matrix.

classification_definitions.EXISTING_ISSUE_OR_PR: Related existing upstream issue or PR; mechanism match need not be the identical instance.
classification_definitions.OFFICIAL_REPOSITORY_RECORD: Official merged PR/test/warning record; not necessarily a user manual or a warning on every call.
classification_definitions.NEWLY_REPORTED: A report newly filed by the project; does not establish novelty or maintainer agreement.
